title: Cortex WorkRequest (DRAFT v0)
description: What a surface (PLO/pocket-agent) submits to be enqueued. This is the initial submission before becoming a TaskEnvelope. Per ADR-0014, authored once in cortex/contracts/ and imported by every consumer.

id.description: ULID/UUID — client-generated idempotency key, stable across retries.

refined_prompt.description: The refined/punched-up prompt ready for execution.

acceptance_criteria.description: Definition-of-done criteria the grader will check.

requested_by.description: Identity of the requesting user or system.

created_at.description: When the request was created (ISO-8601 UTC).
